title: Overview
text:
Cue My Music: Downloads 
 Find songs by name or link and save them into a resource pack for Cue My Music. 
 Search on the player's  Downloads  page, or paste a YouTube or Spotify link.  yt-dlp  downloads it,  ffmpeg  converts it to Ogg, and it lands in a resource pack called  Cue My Music Downloads , which is turned on for you. 
  
   Link  Downloads   
 
  Song or video  That song.  
  Playlist or album  Up to 200 songs, plus a Cue My Music playlist of the same name.  
  Artist or channel  Up to 1000 songs under that artist. Again later adds only new ones.  
  Spotify (any of the above)  Spotify's metadata through  spotdl , audio from YouTube.  
   
 Downloads are add-on songs: they play in Cue My Music's  Add-ons  mode only. Only download what you have the right to. 
 You install yt-dlp, ffmpeg and spotdl: the add-on doesn't include or download them. It contacts YouTube Music for searches and YouTube for thumbnails, and iTunes for album covers. The tools contact the sites in the links you give them. 
  GitHub Releases ↗

title: Install
text:
Install 
 
  Cue My Music  1.4.0+ with its requirements. 
 yt-dlp and ffmpeg (the add-on doesn't download them), and for Spotify links spotdl ( pipx install spotdl ):
  
   System  Command   
 
  macOS   brew install yt-dlp ffmpeg vorbis-tools   
  Windows   winget install yt-dlp.yt-dlp Gyan.FFmpeg   
  Linux  Your package manager for ffmpeg, and  pipx install yt-dlp : distro yt-dlp is often too old for YouTube.  
    
 The jar from  Releases  in  mods . 
 
 Tools are found on  PATH  and in  /opt/homebrew/bin ,  /usr/local/bin ,  /usr/bin ,  /snap/bin ,  ~/.local/bin  and WinGet's  Links , since launchers often drop the shell's  PATH . A tool installed mid-game is picked up on the next download.

title: Use
text:
Use 
 Open the player and click  Downloads  in the library. It has two tabs. 
 Find songs 
 
 Type a song or artist and press Enter. Results come from YouTube Music, official releases first; slowed, sped-up, lyric and cover uploads sink unless you ask for them. If YouTube Music can't be reached, YouTube is searched instead. 
 Download the top card or a row's arrow. A tick means you have it already.  Sort ,  Show more  (up to 30) and past-search buttons sit above the list. 
 An artist search puts an  Artist  card first, with  Download all . 
 Paste a link instead and press Enter.  Cancel  stops it and keeps what finished. Missing tools are named, with the command to install them. 
 Spotify songs are matched to YouTube Music. Unclear matches (remix, live, different length) wait for  Keep ,  Skip  or  Skip all . 
 
 Downloaded 
 Your songs, with a filter box. Right-click →  Delete download , or select several and press Delete.  Open folder  opens the pack. 
 Commands 
  
   Command  Does   
 
   /cmm download <link>   Downloads it; progress shows above the hotbar.  
   /cmm download cancel   Stops it; also answers a pending match with Skip.  
   /cmm downloads   Lists songs. Click the pack name to open its folder.  
   /cmm downloads remove <song>   Deletes one.  
   
 Rules 
 
 One download at a time. Live streams and anything over an hour are skipped, as are private, removed or region-locked videos in a playlist. 
  watch?v=…&list=…  downloads the one video; use  playlist?list=…  for the list. 
 Title and artist come from the site's track data, else the video title and uploader ("Artist - Topic" becomes "Artist"). Spotify keeps Spotify's. 
 Downloading a song again replaces it; artist and Spotify links skip songs you have. 
 Each download or removal reads only the song list again, so the song that's on keeps playing. The first download turns the pack on, which reloads resources and stops what's playing. 
 With Cue My Music's defaults, downloads automix (matched loudness, blends up to 8 s) and stay out of game-audio recordings (rec-util, OBS app capture). Both are in its Settings.

title: The pack
text:
The pack 
  A normal folder in  resourcepacks : copy or share it as is. Delete it, or turn it off under Resource Packs, to remove everything. 
  resourcepacks/Cue My Music Downloads/
  pack.mcmeta
  assets/cuemymusic_dl/
    sounds.json        one sound event, cuemymusic_dl:music.downloads
    cuemymusic.json    each song's title, artist, album, and link
    sounds/music/*.ogg named by video id
  
 Sound quality 
 Minecraft plays only Ogg Vorbis, so songs are converted at libvorbis quality 10 (about 400 kbps, 15 MB for 5 minutes). The source is already about 130 kbps Opus; any lower and drums smear audibly. 
 Windows and Linux ffmpeg include libvorbis.  Homebrew's doesn't : install  vorbis-tools  and its  oggenc  is used. Without either, ffmpeg's weaker built-in encoder is used and the Downloads page warns; download again after fixing it.

title: Troubleshooting
text:
Troubleshooting 
   
 
 
 Problem 
 Fix 
 
 
 
 
  Couldn't find yt-dlp  or  ffmpeg  
 Install it (the page shows the command), or link it into  /usr/local/bin  or  ~/.local/bin . 
 
 
  Couldn't find spotdl , or a Spotify link says it needs it 
  pipx install spotdl  
 
 
 A Spotify song matched the wrong video 
 Press  Skip  (or  Skip all ) at the question. 
 
 
  Download failed  from YouTube 
 Update yt-dlp ( brew upgrade yt-dlp ,  winget upgrade yt-dlp.yt-dlp , or  yt-dlp -U ). Sites change often. 
 
 
 The song isn't in the player 
 Check that  Cue My Music Downloads  is on under Resource Packs. 
 
 
  
 yt-dlp's full output for a failed download is in  logs/latest.log .

title: Changelog
text:
Changelog  All notable changes to Cue My Music: Downloads are documented here. This project follows  Semantic Versioning . 
 [Unreleased] 
 [1.1.0] - 2026-11-06 
 Requires Cue My Music 1.4.0 or newer. 
 Added 
 
  Artist downloads : a YouTube channel or artist link, or an  Artist → Download all  card in search results, downloads the whole channel (up to 1000 songs). Songs already in the pack are skipped, so running it again only adds what's new. Cue My Music already groups them by artist, so no playlist is made. 
  Spotify links , through spotdl: songs, albums, playlists and artists. spotdl only reads the Spotify metadata; the audio comes from a YouTube Music match. Spotify playlists and albums make a Cue My Music playlist named after them. Install spotdl with  pipx install spotdl ; it's optional, and only Spotify links need it. 
  Check uncertain matches : when a Spotify song's YouTube match isn't clear (a remix, a live version, a different length), the Downloads page shows both and asks  Keep ,  Skip , or  Skip all  before continuing. 
  Tabs on the Downloads page , styled as the player's Mode switch:  Find songs  for search, links and progress, and  Downloaded  for the songs already saved, with a box to filter them by title or artist. 
  Song covers : every song gets its own cover, shown in Cue My Music: its album's cover from iTunes where it has the song, otherwise its YouTube thumbnail cut square. Songs downloaded before get theirs in the background, a few a minute, and thumbnails are swapped for album covers where one is found. 
  More search tools : sort results by relevance, plays, length or title;  Show more  for up to 30 results; and recent searches as buttons. 
 
 Changed 
 
 Shorter, plainer text: the Downloads page help, chat messages while downloading, and the mod list description. 
 Songs are converted to Ogg as each one finishes, not after the whole link, so long artist and playlist downloads use less disk and cancelling keeps the finished songs. 
 Spotify songs already in the pack are skipped, like artist downloads. 
 The Downloads pack has no picture any more: it looked like a player and stood in as every song's cover. 
 Downloading or deleting songs no longer reloads every resource: only the song list is read again, so it's quick and the song that's on keeps playing instead of skipping. 
 
 Fixed 
 
 Downloading outside Add-ons mode says to switch to Add-ons to play the songs. 
 The README no longer says downloads play from the player only: Add-ons mode picks them. 
 Downloading an artist no longer saves the same song twice when it's on both a single and an album, or is already downloaded. 
 
 [1.0.0] - 2026-10-27 
 First release. Requires Cue My Music 1.3.0 or newer. 
 Added 
 
  Search by name : type a song or artist on the Downloads page. Results come from YouTube Music's song search, official releases first, with covers, and fall back to YouTube if YouTube Music can't be reached. 
  Downloads page  in the player, with progress, Cancel, a tick on songs you already have, and the list of downloaded songs. 
  Downloads into a resource pack  with yt-dlp and ffmpeg, from the Downloads page or  /cmm download <link> . 
  Playlists : a playlist link downloads every song (up to 200) and makes a Cue My Music playlist with the same name. Downloading it again adds only the new songs. 
  Delete several downloads at once : shift-click to select, then press Delete. 
  Sound quality : songs are encoded at libvorbis quality 10, through  oggenc  when ffmpeg lacks libvorbis. 
  Vanilla music : with Cue My Music's Vanilla music switch on, the  /cmm download  commands are hidden.

title: Develop
text:
Develop 
  Requires JDK 25 and a built Cue My Music in  ../cue-my-music  ( ./gradlew buildAll  there), which the add-on compiles against for playlists; see  gradle.properties . Then  ./gradlew build  builds the jar into  build/libs/ .
